descriptionHtml:
This Kevin Spacey face mask shows the American actor, printed in full colour on thick card and cut to shape. It's made for satire, theatre productions and film-themed fancy dress for adults.

Kevin Spacey Face Mask for Satire and Theatre

Each mask is digitally printed on 350gsm silk card, cut around the face, with the eye holes already cut out. Thread the elastic through, tie it to fit and it's ready for rehearsal or the stage. Need a face we don't list? We can make a custom mask from your own photo, so call us on 01439 771468.

Why you'll love it

  • Full A4 size (297 x 210 mm), so it covers an adult face
  • A simple costume piece for satirical sketches about Hollywood
  • Lightweight card is easy to wear and remove between scenes
  • Thick 350gsm silk card that keeps its shape under stage lights
  • Semi-waterproof finish for repeated use in rehearsals

Size & details

  • Size: 297 x 210 mm (A4), a full adult-size face
  • Material: 350gsm silk card, full-colour digital print
  • Finish: semi-waterproof
  • Fit: one size for adults; elastic included
  • Pre-cut eye holes; cut to the shape of the face
  • Packaging: board-backed envelope

Delivery

Printed in-house at our North Yorkshire workshop and posted to you flat in a board-backed envelope. Dispatch and postage options are shown at checkout.
